summary_1line: Rama recounts King Ila, a powerful ruler who enters Shiva’s enchanted forest and is transformed into a woman along with all his followers.

image_candidates.scene_text: King Ila rides into Shiva’s sacred forest and suddenly realizes that he and his entire army have been transformed into women.
Shiva, laughing beside Parvati among waterfalls, addresses the distressed transformed king in the enchanted forest.
Across the forest every creature and even the trees appear in female form under Shiva’s mysterious power.
